consolidated_summary: The page contrasts Candidate gene association mapping with Genome-wide Association (GWA) methods, highlighting GWA’s advantages in detecting common alleles and using a fine-mapping approach that is blind to prior hypotheses.
consolidated_key_facts: GWA can detect common genetic variants associated with complex traits.
GWA employs a fine-mapping approach that does not rely on prior hypotheses.
